selectionRationale: Use keyframe-led image-to-video for character and prop continuity. Wan2.2-I2V-A14B is the quality target; a one-time local qualification chooses the highest quantization that completes safely. Wan2.2-TI2V-5B is the reliable fallback.

primary.weightFormat: GGUF through ComfyUI-GGUF or another documented compatible loader

generation.notes: Import the current official ComfyUI Wan2.2 14B I2V workflow and map these as tunable starting values; do not assume stale node IDs.

preview.mode: current official or documented four-step acceleration workflow
preview.purpose: hardware qualification, prompt smoke tests, and UI preview only

preferred.accessNote: Official weights may require a one-time model access acceptance; never use an unverified mirror.

keyframe.optionalAnimeLoraPolicy: disabled by default; enable only after recording source, checksum, and license that permits the intended release

upscale.preferredFamily: Real-ESRGAN anime video model or repository-approved equivalent

post.grain: subtle, consistent final-pass grain after upscale; never use grain to conceal broken frames
